harness.runguard.clock: fail closed: every reading through CombinedLedger.tick (new maxima persisted); a backward reading persists clock_halt and raises ClockInconsistent; halted until authoritative termination of every instance active at the halt and a clock at or above the recorded maximum (clear_clock_halt); local durations are ticks (never negative); authoritative records are complete and can only add time (max(local, authoritative)); no clamping
harness.runguard.closed_and_lost_instances: canary() and every unit operation require an active, non-lost instance; closing, loss or authoritative termination irreversibly disposes of unbracketed attempts (attempt_disposed events); canaries after an instance's closure never count; run_units validates lifecycle and clock before resolve
harness.runguard.contract_binding: sha256 of the full attestation persisted; a different contract on resume raises ContractMismatch unless a persisted technical ContractTransition is recorded; results and canaries count only under their own contract (earlier results become superseded_contract, never eligible)
harness.runguard.contract_generations: each attestation/transition is a new generation; attempts and canaries bind to (digest, generation); a transition back to an earlier digest is a new generation and never reactivates earlier attempts or canaries
harness.runguard.eligibility: each attempt stored as <unit>.a<n>; resolve() returns the first canary-eligible attempt in event order; retained-ineligible attempts kept; pending attempts not complete
harness.runguard.fallback_identity: registered fallback payload and sha256 persisted at registration and with every fallback; a different fallback on resume raises FallbackMismatch
harness.runguard.instance_lifecycle: units only on a registered active instance (InstanceNotOpen); duplicate opening idempotent, earliest opening kept; closed ids never reopened; authoritative records (provider / dead-man) override local times via reconcile_instance
harness.runguard.launch_attestation: LaunchAttestation: inert identity bitwise, 1-vs-2-GPU parity bitwise, canary reference sha256, engine-config sha256, evidence; checked at construction
harness.runguard.log_integrity: a partial last line, invalid record, broken hash chain, log shorter than its head or a changed already-read record raises LogCorrupt on every operation; repair_torn_tail (partial last line only) quarantines the torn bytes, cuts back to the last verified record and appends log_repaired, ending the ownership; any other damage needs audited manual restoration
harness.runguard.lost_instances: declare_lost: persisted technical, outcome-blind disposition; authoritative close at termination (charged); unbracketed attempts retained-ineligible; no fabricated canary; attempt counts kept
harness.runguard.module: wsp.wm.runguard.ProductionGuard: the mandatory guard of harness.run_units (keyword-only; an explicit EngineeringGuard for non-confirmatory runs)
harness.runguard.owner_epoch: constructing a ProductionGuard appends owner_epoch (next epoch); every operation of an object with an older epoch or contract generation raises StaleGuard before reading out or writing anything; succeeded/failed must match the owner's own in-flight attempt_start
harness.runguard.persistence: one append-only, fsync'd, hash-chained study log per state directory (study.jsonl; global gap-free sequence; each record carries the previous record's sha256; study.jsonl.head holds the last sequence and hash); ledger, clock, retry and relaunch counters, canaries, contract generations, lifecycle, loss dispositions, fallbacks and the owner epoch are all derived by replaying it (StudyState); no other state files (the pre-§II.27 events/ledger/retry layout is refused; CanaryBook removed)

invariants: I0 gap-free unique sequence, hash chain, head
I2 no unit under a stale owner, without instance, halted, above cap, beyond 3 attempts, or after resolution
I4 canary brackets and payload digest
I5 returned results equal the model; stability; fallback digest
property_test.oracle: independent replay of the raw log bytes (Model), sharing no runguard code
property_test.retained_objects: every constructed guard kept in a pool and reused at random

harness.runguard.result_identity: attempt_ok records the payload sha256; resolve verifies the stored payload against it (ResultMismatch); begin refuses a unit with an eligible result or fallback (UnitResolved)
harness.runguard.serialisation: every public operation takes an exclusive fcntl.flock on study.jsonl.lock, re-reads and verifies the tail since its cached sequence, re-validates (owner epoch, contract generation, clock, lifecycle, cap, retries, in-flight attempt) and appends under the same lock

calibration.rule: common random numbers: the same 16 calibration replicates (seeds CAL_SEED0 + 300..315) at every kappa in {0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 1.00, 1.10}; kappa* by linear interpolation (or extrapolation) between the two grid points whose pooled median static held-out SE-scaled |error| (h = 3-4) is nearest the target; registered to two decimals
